title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) is Legacy Capital Partners Inc.’s Largest Position

text:
Legacy Capital Partners Inc. trimmed its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2.5% in the 3rd quarter, according to the company in its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The institutional investor owned 62,870 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 1,625 shares during the period. Apple accounts for 6.5% of Legacy Capital Partners Inc.’s portfolio, making the stock its largest position. Legacy Capital Partners Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $14,191,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
Several other institutional investors and hedge funds also recently added to or reduced their stakes in the company. Planning Directions Inc. acquired a new position in Apple in the 1st quarter worth approximately $2,908,000. Lido Advisors LLC boosted its stake in Apple by 16.2% in the 1st quarter. Lido Advisors LLC now owns 77,594 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $13,018,000 after purchasing an additional 10,814 shares during the period. Schnieders Capital Management LLC boosted its stake in Apple by 4.4% in the 1st quarter. Schnieders Capital Management LLC now owns 45,380 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $7,614,000 after purchasing an additional 1,933 shares during the period. Artisan Partners Limited Partnership boosted its stake in Apple by 0.4% in the 1st quarter. Artisan Partners Limited Partnership now owns 482,515 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $80,956,000 after purchasing an additional 2,004 shares during the period. Finally, Matarin Capital Management LLC acquired a new position in Apple in the 1st quarter worth approximately $10,043,000. 57.08% of the stock is owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors. A number of research firms recently commented on AAPL. DA Davidson reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $280.00 price objective (down previously from $290.00) on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, December 14th. Piper Jaffray Companies cut their target price on shares of Apple from $250.00 to $222.00 and set an “overweight” rating for the company in a research report on Thursday, December 13th. UBS Group reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $210.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday, December 11th. JPMorgan Chase & Co. set a $266.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Tuesday, December 11th. Finally, Wolfe Research assumed coverage on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday, December 11th. They issued a “market perform” rating for the company. Three research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-four have issued a hold rating and twenty-four have issued a buy rating to the stock. Apple has a consensus rating of “Hold” and a consensus target price of $222.77.
In related news, insider Luca Maestri sold 100,245 shares of Apple stock in a transaction on Thursday, October 4th. The shares were sold at an average price of $228.56, for a total value of $22,911,997.20. Following the transaction, the insider now owns 91,665 shares in the company, valued at approximately $20,950,952.40. The sale was disclosed in a legal filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is accessible through this hyperlink . Also, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of Apple stock in a transaction on Monday, November 19th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total transaction of $647,520.00. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now owns 8,940 shares in the company, valued at approximately $1,698,600. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold a total of 204,845 shares of company stock worth $47,015,677 in the last 90 days. 0.06% of the stock is owned by insiders.
Apple stock opened at $166.07 on Wednesday. The firm has a market cap of $805.79 billion, a PE ratio of 13.94, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.18 and a beta of 1.20. The company has a current ratio of 1.12, a quick ratio of 1.09 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87. Apple Inc. has a 1-year low of $150.24 and a 1-year high of $233.47.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 earnings per share for the quarter, beating analysts’ consensus estimates of $2.78 by $0.13. The business had revenue of $62.90 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $61.55 billion. Apple had a net margin of 22.41% and a return on equity of 48.68%. Apple’s revenue for the quarter was up 19.6% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter last year, the firm earned $2.07 EPS. On average, research analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 13.33 EPS for the current year.

Apple Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
